definitions.git add: Stages changes for the next commit
definitions.git commit: Saves staged changes as a snapshot
definitions.git merge: Joins another branch into this one
definitions.git rebase: Replays commits onto a new base
definitions.grep: Searches text; not a Git command
definitions.chmod: Changes permissions; not a Git command
definitions.cat: Prints file contents; not a Git command
definitions.npm install: Fetches packages; not a file command
definitions.pip install: Installs Python packages; not a file command
definitions.docker run: Starts a container; not a file command
definitions.ssh: Remote login; not a file command
definitions.Branch: A movable pointer to a line of commits
definitions.HEAD: Pointer to your current commit
definitions.Remote: A copy of the repo hosted elsewhere
definitions.Tag: A fixed label on a commit, e.g. v1.0
definitions.Staging area: Where changes wait before a commit
definitions.Merge conflict: Two changes touch the same lines
definitions.Detached HEAD: HEAD points at a commit, not a branch
definitions.origin: Default name of the remote you cloned
definitions.Symlink: File pointing to another path; not Git
definitions.Environment var: Named setting for processes; not Git
definitions.Process ID: Number identifying a process; not Git
